headline: BBVA Colombia Implements Governance Rules for Shareholder Meetings
summary: BBVA Colombia announced institutional measures to ensure equal shareholder treatment, specifying that bank employees cannot represent third-party shares at general assembly meetings.
why: BBVA Colombia is one of Colombia's largest commercial banks, controlled by Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria.

impacts.name: BBVA Colombia
impacts.why: Updated voting guidelines bolster minority shareholder protection standards.
